LegacyLens UI Audit Fixes

## Stories

### 1. Fix Hydration & Theme Sync (High Priority)
Fix ThemeProvider to prevent hydration mismatches. Ensure theme state is consistent between server and client rendering.

### 2. Complete Lucide Icon Migration (High Priority)
Unify iconography across all game components and PlayPage by completing migration to Lucide icons. Replace any custom SVG icons or pre-migration icon usage with consistent Lucide equivalents.

### 3. Framer Motion Animation Migration (Medium Priority)
Replace manual requestAnimationFrame and setInterval animation loops in SimilarityShowdown.tsx and RoutineRoulette.tsx with Framer Motion declarative animations. Use AnimatePresence for score reveals and spring physics for roulette spin. This eliminates memory leak risk and React lifecycle issues.

### 4. Accessibility Improvements (Medium Priority)
- Add aria-live regions to game feedback (correct/wrong announcements, mistakes remaining)
- Fix focus management on game transitions (auto-focus new primary action on round change/game end)
- Audit color contrast for difficultyColors in ConnectionsGame against both Punch Card and Blueprint themes for WCAG AA compliance

### 5. Layout Hardening for Code Snippets (Low Priority)
- Standardize max-h and overflow behavior for all code preview elements (pre tags in RoutineRoulette, SimilarityShowdown)
- Add overflow-x-auto and break-words for long Fortran lines on mobile
- Review fixed max-w constraints on ConnectionsGame and PersonalityQuiz for small mobile screens
